title: 先把原视频交给AI逐秒拆解成时间轴Prompt（按秒写分镜与动作），再把这套逐秒Prompt喂给Seedance做1:1复刻
content:
先把原视频交给AI逐秒拆解成时间轴Prompt（按秒写分镜与动作），再把这套逐秒Prompt喂给Seedance做1:1复刻  
用Seedance 2.0做1:1复刻时在总风格里明确：真实主义TikTok爆款电影感、竖屏4K、现实光影、动态运镜、反转戏剧张力  
按时间轴分镜写Prompt来控节奏：0-3秒紧张铺垫（母子搬脏沙发+警车闪灯冲来）/3-7秒反转动作（警察急刹下车喷清洁剂并疯狂擦，强调丝滑动作+泡沫）/7-11秒结果变化（沙发瞬间变新+母子震惊）/11-15秒收尾（警察竖拇指+产品特写）  
把长视频（如98秒）先剪成15秒短版再用Seedance生成，优先保留前3秒强反转以提升短视频爆点

en.content:
First, give the original video to the AI to break it down into a timeline prompt second by second (writing the storyboard and actions per second), then feed this second-by-second prompt to Seedance for a 1:1 replication.  
When using Seedance 2.0 for a 1:1 replication, clearly define the overall style: realistic TikTok viral cinematic feel, vertical 4K, realistic lighting and shadows, dynamic camera movement, dramatic tension with reversals.  
Write prompts according to the timeline storyboard to control the pace: 0-3 seconds for a tense setup (mother and son moving a dirty sofa + police car with flashing lights rushing in) / 3-7 seconds for reversal action (police officer brakes hard, gets out, sprays cleaner and scrubs frantically, emphasizing smooth action + foam) / 7-11 seconds for outcome change (sofa instantly looks new + mother and son are shocked) / 11-15 seconds for conclusion (police officer gives a thumbs up + product close-up).  
First, cut the long video (e.g., 98 seconds) into a 15-second short version, then generate with Seedance, prioritizing the retention of the strong reversal in the first 3 seconds to enhance the short video’s impact.

--- THREAD CONTINUATION ---
[Thread 1] The prompt template has been posted below 👇 (for Seedance 2.0 1:1 replication)

【Overall Style】Realistic TikTok viral cinematic feel, vertical 4K, realistic lighting and shadows, dynamic camera movement, dramatic tension with reversals

【Timeline Storyboard】
0-3 seconds: Black mother and son moving a dirty sofa by the roadside, police car with flashing lights rushing in, tense atmosphere
3-7 seconds: Police officer brakes hard, gets out, takes out cleaner, sprays + scrubs the sofa frantically (smooth action + foam)
7-11 seconds: Sofa instantly looks new, mother and son are stunned
11-15 seconds: Police officer gives a thumbs up, product close-up to conclude

Full prompt + my practical screenshots/video process can be found in the main post above.  
If you want to copy and run directly, type "1" and I'll privately send you the optimized version.

[Thread 2] Update: I’ve cut the 98-second full version into a 15-second explosive reversal short version (the first 3 seconds are hilarious) 👇

Al hacer una recreación 1:1 con Seedance 2.0, especifica en el estilo general: realismo con sensación cinematográfica de éxito en TikTok, vertical 4K, iluminación realista, movimiento dinámico de cámara, tensión dramática de giro.  
Escribe el Prompt según el guion gráfico de la línea de tiempo para controlar el ritmo: 0-3 segundos de tensión inicial (madre e hijo moviendo un sofá sucio + luces de policía acercándose) / 3-7 segundos de acción de giro (policía frena bruscamente, baja del coche, rocía limpiador y limpia frenéticamente, enfatizando movimientos fluidos + espuma) / 7-11 segundos de cambio de resultado (sofá se vuelve nuevo instantáneamente + madre e hijo asombrados) / 11-15 segundos de cierre (policía levanta el pulgar + primer plano del producto).  
Corta el video largo (como de 98 segundos) a una versión corta de 15 segundos y luego genera con Seedance, priorizando mantener los primeros 3 segundos de fuerte giro para aumentar el impacto del video corto.

--- CONTINUACIÓN DEL HILO ---

Seedance 2.0で1:1再現する際には、全体のスタイルを明確にします：リアリズム、TikTokでバズる映画的感覚、縦型4K、現実的な光と影、動的なカメラワーク、逆転のドラマチックな緊張感。  
タイムラインに沿ってシーンを記述し、Promptでリズムをコントロールします：0-3秒は緊張の布石（母子が汚れたソファを運ぶ+パトカーのライトが近づく）/3-7秒は逆転のアクション（警官が急ブレーキで車を降り、クリーナーを噴射して狂ったように拭く、滑らかな動き+泡を強調）/7-11秒は結果の変化（ソファが瞬時に新しくなり、母子が驚く）/11-15秒は締め（警官が親指を立て、製品のクローズアップ）。  
長い動画（例えば98秒）をまず15秒の短いバージョンに編集し、Seedanceで生成します。短い動画の爆発力を高めるために、最初の3秒の強い逆転を優先的に残します。

Ao fazer a recriação 1:1 com o Seedance 2.0, defina claramente no estilo geral: sensação cinematográfica de sucesso no TikTok realista, 4K em tela vertical, iluminação realista, movimento dinâmico de câmera, tensão dramática de reviravolta.  
Escreva o Prompt por quadros na linha do tempo para controlar o ritmo: 0-3 segundos de tensão crescente (mãe e filho movendo um sofá sujo + luzes piscando de uma viatura policial se aproximando) / 3-7 segundos de ação de reviravolta (policial freia bruscamente, sai do carro, borrifa limpador e esfrega freneticamente, enfatizando movimentos suaves + espuma) / 7-11 segundos de mudança de resultado (sofá instantaneamente novo + mãe e filho chocados) / 11-15 segundos de encerramento (policial faz sinal de positivo + close no produto).  
Corte o vídeo longo (como 98 segundos) em uma versão curta de 15 segundos antes de gerar com o Seedance, priorizando manter os 3 segundos iniciais de forte reviravolta para aumentar o impacto do vídeo curto.

--- CONTINUAÇÃO DA THREAD ---
